description: This file defines the LDAPSyncStatusDecorator class, which provides a wrapper around the LDAPSyncStatus entity. It offers methods to set synchronization details and retrieve formatted synchronization dates and times. The class utilizes traits for ORM entity management and date/time helpers, facilitating LDAP synchronization status management for the application.

classes.name: LDAPSyncStatusDecorator
classes.description: A decorator class for LDAPSyncStatus entity, providing additional functionality for managing LDAP synchronization status, including setting synced users and retrieving formatted sync start/end dates and times.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the decorator with an LDAPSyncStatus entity instance.

methods.name: setSyncedUserByUserId
methods.description: Sets the user who performed the sync operation based on a provided user ID.

methods.name: getSyncStartedDate
methods.description: Returns the start date of the sync operation formatted as a string, or null if not available.

methods.name: getSyncStartedTime
methods.description: Returns the start time of the sync operation formatted as a string, or null if not available.

methods.name: getSyncFinishedDate
methods.description: Returns the finish date of the sync operation formatted as a string, or null if not available.

methods.name: getSyncFinishedTime
methods.description: Returns the finish time of the sync operation formatted as a string, or null if not available.
